description: Extract structured data from one public page: tables (headers + rows), JSON-LD blocks, and Open Graph/Twitter/canonical/language metadata. When to use: the page has tables or schema.org JSON-LD you need as data, without an LLM. Do not use: when you only need the page text (web_fetch) or a screenshot (web_screenshot). Returns: {ok, url, final_url, title, meta:{description,image,site_name,type,canonical,lang}, jsonld[], tables:[{caption,headers,rows}], links? , cached, took_ms, _metering}. Metered: shares the web free bucket (50 calls/day per IP), then 1 credit per call over x402.

include_links.description: Also return same-host links (max 100). Default false.

name: web_extract
title: Web Extract
